en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an outdoor cafe or beer garden with numerous tables and chairs covered with checkered tablecloths, set under large trees. There are also umbrellas above some tables. In the background, there is a traditional building typical of Central European parks. The overall setting appears peaceful and inviting, likely captured in the early-to-mid 20th century. The text on the postcard identifies the location.
